name: Áed mac Fidga
text: Áed mac Fidga is another name for Goll mac Moma, the Connacht warrior. MacKillop reads the form as an alternative patronymic for the famous Ulster-cycle hero. The principal record sits under Goll mac Moma.

attributes.attribute: Alternative name for Goll mac Moma; pointer to Goll mac Moma headword

okr.objective: Áed mac Fidga is a MacKillop signpost to Goll mac Moma.
